payload.description:
Follow-up to plx-50029c: ConsoleChatResponder can now apply data protection policy on /plexus/procedures/* but still fails on /plexus/console/* with AccessDenied for logs:PutDataProtectionPolicy.

Fix: extend IAM log-group resource scope for ConsoleChatResponder to include /plexus/console/* (and child streams) for existing CloudWatch Logs actions and policy application.
payload.title: Allow console worker data-protection policy on /plexus/console log groups
